articles.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
articles.snippet: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.

articles.title: This New AI Music Model Is Already Better Than Suno—We Put ACE to the Test
articles.snippet: ACE Music v1 tops the AI music rankings with more natural vocals and stronger song structure. Our tests found impressive results, though niche genres remain a challenge.
